item.title: Kerry Rose
item.description: Kerry Rose, 66, Taylors, S.C., beloved husband of Tracey Rose, died on Tuesday, Dec. 30, 2025. He was born on July 29, 1959, in Marion, to the late Merle Rose Sr. and Ruth Evelyn Berkey Rose. Kerry lived an active, generous life rooted in athletics, mentorship, and community. … Read More

item.title: Most Milford Council Members To Seek Re-Election
item.description: Candidate filing for the 2026 primary begins Wednesday, Jan. 7, and most of Milford’s town council members plan to seek re-election this year.

item.title: Beckwith, OCRA Announce 11 Communities To Receive $2.6M In Funding
item.description: The office of Lt. Gov. Micah Beckwith and the Indiana Office of Community and Rural Affairs today announced 11 Indiana communities will receive $2,680,000 in Owner Occupied Rehabilitation Grants and Planning Grants through the Community Development Block Grant program.

item.title: Commercial Pesticide Applicators Workshops Jan. 28, 29
item.description: Did you know that people who apply pesticides for hire must be licensed and keep that license up to date by attending classes over the course of the five-year life of a license?

item.title: Indiana Democrats Push For State Response To Growing Costs For Families
item.description: Legislative Democrats want state government to do more to help Indiana families deal with rising costs.

item.title: LEPC Announces 2026 Meeting Dates
item.description: Meeting dates for the Kosciusko County Local Emergency Planning Committee have been announced for 2026.

item.title: Valley FFA Forestry and Entomology teams advance to state
item.description: The Tippecanoe Valley FFA Forestry & Entomology teams advanced to the state contest Saturday, Jan. 10, after competing in the Area X contest in November at Oregon Davis High School, Hamlet.

item.title: Online Lottery Bill Advances, Ban Eyed On Other Internet Gambling
item.description: Indiana legislators are talking about possibly banning one form of internet gambling while also giving the Hoosier Lottery permission to sell tickets online.

item.title: Braun Boasts Drug, Traffic Enforcement As Latest Public Safety Wins
item.description: Gov. Mike Braun on Tuesday, Jan 6 touted what his administration called major public safety gains in its first year, pointing to large drug seizures, stepped-up traffic enforcement and a sharp decline in overdose deaths as evidence that Indiana is “safer” under his watch.

item.title: Brent Johnson Approved As Triton Multi-School Building Corporation Board Member
item.description: Staff Report BOURBON – Brent Johnson was approved as a member of the board of directors for the Triton Multi-School Building Corporation Board during a brief organizational meeting on Tuesday, Jan. 6.
